2609.15659.title: KaiNinja: Extending Native 3D Generators to the Part Level
2609.15659.paper_summary: Native 3D generators turn one image into a single mesh. TRELLIS.2 and its peers deliver high-fidelity non-watertight geometry with materials, but the output is one fused object, while downstream work such as editing, rigging and simulation operates on part-level assets. A naive idea is to run a 3D segmentation network on the fused mesh that TRELLIS.2 generates, but such pipelines are slow and bounded by the accuracy of the segmentation. We want a simple way to extend an existing native 3D generator to the part level. But we face a critical problem: the O-Voxel grid stores one sheet of surface per voxel, so a single volume cannot represent the interface where two parts touch, at any resolution. We introduce a dual-volume representation to solve this problem and put forward KaiNinja, a part-level extension of TRELLIS.2 built on a dual-volume form of its O-Voxel representation. KaiNinja keeps the generation speed and quality of TRELLIS.2 while extending it to the part level, with no mask or segmenter in the pipeline. Its training data come from sources of many kinds, including CAD models and assets authored by an LLM-driven agent; to our knowledge it is the first 3D generative model trained on agent-authored part data. Surprisingly, we also find that whole-object fidelity improves over the same backbone fine-tuned on the same dataset. Against part generation pipelines of different paradigms, it lowers whole-object Chamfer distance by 40% and raises strict part F-score by 16%.
2609.15659.paper_summary_zh: 原生 3D 生成器將一個圖像轉換為單一的網格。TRELLIS.2 及其同類產品提供高保真的非密閉幾何體，並帶有材料，但輸出是一個融合的物體，而下游工作如編輯、裝配和模擬則在部件級資產上進行。一個天真的想法是對 TRELLIS.2 生成的融合網格運行 3D 分割網絡，但這樣的管道速度較慢，並受到分割準確性的限制。我們希望有一種簡單的方法將現有的原生 3D 生成器擴展到部件級別。但我們面臨一個關鍵問題：O-Voxel 網格每個體素存儲一片表面，因此單個體積無法在任何解析度下表示兩個部件接觸的界面。我們引入了一種雙體積表示法來解決這個問題，並提出了 KaiNinja，這是一個基於其 O-Voxel 表示的雙體積形式的 TRELLIS.2 部件級擴展。KaiNinja 保持了 TRELLIS.2 的生成速度和質量，同時將其擴展到部件級別，管道中不需要掩膜或分割器。其訓練數據來自多種來源，包括 CAD 模型和由 LLM 驅動的代理創建的資產；據我們所知，它是第一個基於代理創建的部件數據訓練的 3D 生成模型。令人驚訝的是，我們還發現整體物體的保真度在同一基礎上進行微調後有所改善，並且在不同範式的部件生成管道中，它將整體物體的 Chamfer 距離降低了 40%，並將嚴格的部件 F-score 提高了 16%。
